extracted.intended_audience: voters and the general public; journalists and scholars interested in fact-checking U.S. political claims
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluating and reporting on the factual accuracy of statements made by major U.S. political players (ads, debates, speeches, interviews, news releases), using journalistic and scholarly best practices to inform voters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nonpartisan, nonprofit consumer advocate for voters
rubrics_metrics.description: We are a nonpartisan, nonprofit “consumer advocate” for voters that aims to reduce the level of deception and confusion in U.S. politics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positioning as a nonpartisan, nonprofit entity frames evaluations to avoid partisan bias and to serve voters' interests rather than political actors or parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor factual accuracy of major U.S. political players
rubrics_metrics.description: We monitor the factual accuracy of what is said by major U.S. political players in the form of TV ads, debates, speeches, interviews and news releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scope specifies the subjects (major U.S. political players) and the formats to be checked (TV ads, debates, speeches, interviews, news releases); implies systematic review across these formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply best practices of journalism and scholarship
rubrics_metrics.description: Our goal is to apply the best practices of both journalism and scholarship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combines journalistic standards (verification, sourcing, clear reporting) with scholarly rigor (evidence-based analysis, careful sourcing and contextualization) as the methodological standard for evaluations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase public knowledge and understanding
rubrics_metrics.description: Our goal is to ... increase public knowledge and understanding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outputs should be accessible and educational, aimed at improving voter comprehension of factual matters rather than merely scoring statements as true/false.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affiliation with the Annenberg Public Policy Center and scholarly community
rubrics_metrics.description: FactCheck.org is a project of the Annenberg Public Policy Center of the University of Pennsylvania. The APPC was established ... to create a community of scholars within the University of Pennsylvania that would address public policy issues at the local, state and federal levels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizational affiliation signals reliance on scholarly resources and multi-level public policy expertise; implies standards of institutional oversight and academic-informed practice.
